title: Design: No blue line while the name is not allowed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "net 30" in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: Name reads "net 30".
  • Step 3: under Name the red message "Net 30 is already a standard term. Pick another name." shows, the Days box has no error, and no blue explanation line shows (design note: "No sentence shows while a field is invalid.").
  • Step 4: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Held: the design's behaviour; under the PRD the blue line shows because the number is valid (cases S3-03, D-13). Released or deleted when question 10 is answered (register CT-D03).
